top._headline: Defend incumbent position before MI-SWACO flips ARC Resources
top._insight: Newpark holds ARC Resources' last two Lower Montney contracts and benefits from established trust at the Dawson Creek corridor, but MI-SWACO is actively competing this pad with a closing decision window of approximately August 16 — making this a protect-and-extend play with immediate revenue at stake.
